slides.headline: The AI warning that could affect you
Microsoft warns Anthropic AI risky
slides.body: They said its powerful AI models (computer programs that learn from data) might act unpredictably, threatening jobs and safety.

slides.headline: Could affect your job and privacy
slides.body: If AI systems make unchecked decisions, they might replace workers or misuse personal data.

slides.headline: Anthropic says it builds safe AI
slides.body: The company claims its AI models (computer programs that learn) follow strict safety rules, but Microsoft doubts they're enough.

slides.headline: Stay informed, ask for AI safety
slides.body: Follow news, support policies that require AI companies to test impacts before release.

slides.headline: Follow for AI news
slides.body: Get clear, jargon‑free updates on how AI shapes your life.
